description: Timing and feel of all in-game motion.
prompt_template:
Given these prior picks:
  gameplay_style: {prior_picks.gameplay_style}
  character_style: {prior_picks.character_style}

Generate {count} animation style options covering:
- Frame timing: snappy (100ms) | normal (150ms) | slow (250ms) | variable
- Easing default: linear | inOutCubic | outQuad | inOutBack | custom
- Transition style: cut | crossfade | dither_sweep | mosaic | vcr_pause | slide
- Idle behavior: still | breathe | fidget | look_around | ambient
- Hit reaction: shake | freeze_frame | invert_flash | scale_pop

uses_setOffset_for_shake: true if hit_reaction=shake (triggers playdate.display.setOffset)
uses_setMosaic_for_transitions: true if transition=mosaic
uses_vcrPauseFilterImage: true if transition=vcr_pause (asset must exist)

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the animation option below per the user feedback. Keep the boolean flags consistent with the chosen techniques.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.default_easing: enum: linear | inOutCubic | outQuad | inOutBack | custom
option_schema.transition: enum: cut | crossfade | dither_sweep | mosaic | vcr_pause | slide
option_schema.idle_behavior: enum: still | breathe | fidget | look_around | ambient
option_schema.preview_lua_template: string — a short self-contained Lua snippet that renders this style for the lua_snippet preview kind
